events.evidence: White-team crease attack at the left net, followed by a stoppage and a long gathering around the red goalie. The later restart is at center; the ball crossing is hidden. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

White-team shot toward the left net, goalie drops and looks back, followed by white-team celebration and a center restart. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

Repeated attempts at the left crease, white-team reaction, referee stoppage and a later center restart. The final ball crossing is blocked by players. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

Red-team rush at the left net, close-range attempt and red-team celebration, followed by a center restart. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

White-team attack at the right net, red goalie and defender go down, followed by white-team celebration and a center restart. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

White-team attack at the left net, near the image edge and behind spectators, followed by celebration and a center restart. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.

White-team pressure at the left crease, followed by white-team celebration and a center restart. Players hide the goal mouth. Assistant-reviewed timing after consulting official records; exact ball crossing and game-clock time are not resolved.
